name: Mahali Mzuri Safari Camp
positioning: Sir Richard Branson's tented safari camp in the Olare Motorogi Conservancy, in the Maasai Mara ecosystem
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive safari with twice-daily game drives
Couples and groups looking for balloon flights, walking safaris and Maasai cultural visits

facts.text: Mahali Mzuri is Sir Richard Branson's Kenyan safari camp.
The camp is located within the Olare Motorogi Conservancy in Kenya.
The camp sits in the Maasai Mara ecosystem, in the path of the annual Great Migration.
The Olare Motorogi Conservancy covers over 33,000 acres of protected land.
The conservancy has strict limits on vehicle numbers and guests.
Each guest has their own privately positioned luxury tented suite.
Twice-daily guided game drives, in the early morning and late afternoon, are included in the stay.
Around 150,000 Loita wildebeest live in the conservancy year-round.
Spa treatments are offered at the Nasaro Spa.
Maasai cultural visits range from the weekly market to homestead life and community projects.
All meals, fine wines and spirits are included throughout the stay.

highlights.text: The camp is perched on the side of a lush valley overlooking rolling plains.
A heated infinity pool overlooks the plains.
Sunrise hot air balloon flights come with a champagne breakfast in the bush.
Guests can take guided walking safaris with Maasai warrior guides.
Each tent has an en-suite bathroom and a private deck with views of the wilderness.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires chartered flights or long drives.
Game drives are timed for the early morning and late afternoon.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
